message: HOLD — 3 critical error(s) found. Correct before shipping.

critical_errors.description: Swabs must go into labeled paper envelopes, NOT back into plastic wrappers. Plastic creates moisture that encourages mold and destroys DNA samples.
critical_errors.check: Buccal swabs placed in labeled PAPER envelopes (not plastic)
critical_errors.notes: Swabs placed in plastic bags instead of paper envelopes

critical_errors.description: Labels must be applied one at a time during collection to prevent sample switching. Pre-labeling envelopes = risk of cross-contamination.
critical_errors.check: Envelopes labeled one at a time DURING collection (not pre-labeled)
critical_errors.notes: All envelopes were pre-labeled before collection began

critical_errors.description: The sample collector must be an unrelated third party with no interest in the test outcome. Family members or interested parties cannot collect.
critical_errors.check: Collector is unrelated to participants with no interest in outcome
critical_errors.notes: Collector is the mother of one participant
